curation.lead:
Glenn Dubin is an American billionaire hedge fund manager, co-founder of Highbridge Capital Management and later Engineers Gate, who maintained one of the deepest and most enduring personal relationships with Jeffrey Epstein documented in the case record. With 929 references in the DugganUSA corpus — placing him in the top 20 most-cited individuals — Dubin's entanglement spans financial, social, and legal dimensions. He is named in sworn testimony by Virginia Giuffre and in the Jane Doe 102 complaint as someone to whom victims were directed for sexual encounters at Ghislaine Maxwell's instruction. His wife Eva Dubin is alleged to have been present in the household during at least one such encounter.

The financial architecture connecting Dubin to Epstein centers on Jeepers Inc, an Epstein-controlled entity to which Dubin assigned economic interest in a Fortress Investment Group fund via a formal agreement dated August 1, 2011. Over $4.3 million in Dubin capital flowed through this structure, with distributions tracked through 2017 by Epstein's financial advisor Richard Kahn. The government subpoenaed Jeepers Inc for its organizational structure and relationship to Epstein, indicating prosecutors viewed this flow as significant. Dubin also served as a post-conviction social rehabilitator, introducing Epstein to Pete Briger at Fortress and maintaining intimate friendship — joint dinners, Paris apartment offers, birthday messages — through at least 2018, when the Dubin family facilitated their daughter Celina's use of Epstein as a Soho House membership reference.

Dubin's professional base was Dubin and Company at 767 Fifth Avenue, 45th Floor. He co-founded the Robin Hood Foundation with Paul Tudor Jones and maintained a significant NYC real estate portfolio, including a $30 million Fifth Avenue purchase from David Koch. His political giving, exceeding $147K in FEC-documented contributions, skews Democratic with some bipartisan outlays. The Dubin Family Foundation, separately, has been in terminal wind-down since 2011, with assets approaching full depletion.
curation.system_role: Dubin represents a case study in how an elite hedge fund manager's multi-decade personal friendship with Epstein survived conviction, persisted through the social rehabilitation period, and created documented financial conduits through Epstein-controlled entities — while the same household was named in sworn victim testimony as a site where trafficking victims were directed.

sections.title: The Epstein Relationship and Post-Conviction Rehabilitation
sections.content:
Glenn Dubin's relationship with Jeffrey Epstein is among the longest and most intimate documented in the case record, spanning social, financial, and familial dimensions. Their friendship survived Epstein's 2008 conviction entirely intact. By 2009, Dubin was actively working to reintroduce Epstein to the hedge fund world, forwarding a meeting request to Pete Briger of Fortress Investment Group. Briger's response — "I want to be clear to Jeffrey that I want to help if I can" (EFTA02413555) — reveals the dynamic: Dubin as gatekeeper, vouching for Epstein's continued relevance to institutional finance after a sex offense conviction.

The social relationship remained casual and warm through at least 2018. In April 2014, Dubin sent Epstein a joking AARP birthday card (EFTA01929339). In May 2015, Epstein organized group dinners with the Dubins and Woody Allen, forwarding a dinner menu from Soon-Yi Previn and telling Glenn to "add to if you like, see you thur." Dubin responded afterward: "thanks for a fun night. Hearing the Lone Ranger story and seeing Woody laugh were highlights" (EFTA02502802). The tone is that of close friends, not business associates maintaining a transactional connection.

In June 2015, Epstein offered Dubin use of his Paris apartment "with the family, no problem at all, with driver, etc." In the same exchange, Epstein brokered an introduction to attorney David Boies, to which Dubin replied: "No I haven't but I hear he's incredible as evidenced by what he did for Hank Greenberg" (EFTA02356398). This inquiry predates Boies's later involvement representing Epstein victims and hiring Black Cube — a sequence that underscores how Epstein's social network was deeply interconnected with the legal apparatus that would later pursue him.

As late as February 2018, the Dubin family's entanglement continued: daughter Celina Dubin applied for Soho House membership with Epstein's assistance. The email chain, cc'd to both Epstein and Eva Dubin, shows Celina telling Epstein "on second thought I think a letter from you would be best" (EFTA02533073). The email was sent to Allison Yorke at Dubin and Company, confirming the family office was aware that a convicted sex offender was writing a membership recommendation for a young woman in her early twenties.

sections.title: Jeepers Inc and the Fortress Fund Financial Structure
sections.content:
The financial architecture connecting Dubin to Epstein is built around Jeepers Inc, an Epstein-controlled entity incorporated in the U.S. Virgin Islands as part of the Financial Trust Company constellation. On August 1, 2011, Dubin signed an Assignment of Economic Interest Agreement transferring his interest in a Fortress Investment Group fund to Jeepers Inc. The investment totaled $4,375,302, and subsequent distributions were routed through Jeepers to the Bank of New York (EFTA02385363).

The distribution trail is documented in granular detail. Richard Kahn, Epstein's financial manager, tracked each payment and sought instructions on whether to forward funds to Dubin or hold them. The tracked distributions include: $222,549 (October 2014), $166,911 (December 2014), $244,778 (June 2015), $183,754 (December 2015), $118,050 (September 2016), and $46,854 (June 2017). In October 2016, Kahn emailed Epstein: "Jeepers received funds of 118,049.60 this morning — shall I send on to Glen Dubin or wait? Please advise" (EFTA02447499). The fact that Kahn needed Epstein's permission to release Dubin's own investment returns to Dubin reveals the control dynamic embedded in the structure.

The government recognized the significance of this arrangement. Prosecutors subpoenaed Jeepers Inc demanding production of documents revealing "relationships among Jeepers, FTC, Jeffrey Epstein, and any partner, member, beneficial owner" (EFTA02725955). The subpoena's scope — seeking the full organizational architecture and beneficial ownership — suggests prosecutors viewed the Dubin-Jeepers-Epstein chain as more than a simple investment pass-through. The related entity Financial Trust Company served as Jeepers Inc's parent, with both registered at 6100 Red Hook Quarter B3, St. Thomas, USVI.

Separately, Dubin forwarded a Bloomberg article about Leon Black's tax reform dilemma to Epstein in December 2017, indicating a pattern of intelligence sharing about fellow billionaires through Epstein as intermediary. This mirrors the broader pattern documented across Epstein's network: wealthy clients exchanging commercially sensitive information through Epstein's channel rather than through formal advisors, creating a web of mutual exposure.

sections.title: Victim Testimony and Legal Proceedings
sections.content:
Glenn Dubin is named in two independent evidentiary streams as a recipient of trafficking victims directed by Ghislaine Maxwell and Jeffrey Epstein.

The first stream is Virginia Giuffre's 2016 deposition testimony, unsealed in January 2024. Giuffre testified under oath that Dubin was the first person Maxwell sent her to for sex after completing what Giuffre described as "massage training." Giuffre stated: "Ghislaine told me to go to Glenn Dubin and give him a massage, which means sex." She further testified that Eva Dubin was pregnant and asleep in the next room during the encounter. This testimony was corroborated by the SDNY prosecution memorandum (EFTA02731082, dated December 19, 2019), which documented a victim who said "Maxwell told [her] to massage Glen and Eva Dubin and explicitly told [her] that she had to do to Glen what [she] did for Epstein, which [she] understood to mean engage in sex acts." The victim used the term "lent out" to describe these directed sexual encounters, characterizing it as her first memory of being "lent out."

The second stream is the Jane Doe 102 complaint (HOUSE_OVERSIGHT_022248, 023033, 023036), which explicitly lists Dubin among those the victim "was required to have sex with friends of Ms Maxwell and Mr Epstein, including Glenn Dubin, Les Wexner, Ehud Barak, former Senator George Mitchell and Stephen Kosslyn." This complaint further documented that victims were paid between $200 and $5,000 per encounter depending on travel requirements, and that after encounters with male friends, Maxwell and Epstein would ask explicit questions about what happened. These are separate allegations from separate victims that corroborate each other on the central claim.

The Rinaldo Rizzo connection surfaces in this context as well — Rizzo, the Dubins' former household butler, provided testimony relevant to the legal proceedings. No criminal charges were filed against Glenn Dubin. He has denied the allegations through counsel.

sections.title: Network Position and Philanthropic Activity
sections.content:
Glenn Dubin occupies a distinctive position in the broader Epstein network: a hedge fund billionaire whose relationship was simultaneously social, financial, and — if victim testimony is credited — participatory in the abuse itself. His network bridges several key clusters. Through Paul Tudor Jones, with whom he co-founded the Robin Hood Foundation in 1988 and co-chaired the Dubin Breast Center at Mount Sinai, Dubin connects to the philanthropic hedge fund circle where Epstein circulated. Eva Dubin coordinated Epstein attendance at Robin Hood events and maintained a separate close personal friendship with Sonia Jones (PTJ's wife), described by Epstein as "best friends."

The Dubin real estate portfolio reflects his elite Manhattan positioning. ACRIS records show a $957,000 Bronx condo purchase in February 2003 (listing 9 W 57th Street, Highbridge Capital's address), a $30 million purchase of 1010/1040 Fifth Avenue from David H. Koch in September 2006, and a $13.75 million sale of an Upper East Side property to Alexander Klabin in February 2011. The family maintained addresses at 1010 Fifth Avenue, 40 W 57th Street (Highbridge Capital), and 767 Fifth Avenue (Dubin and Company, the same building as Wachtell Lipton). A Florida LLC (L10000120085) listed Glenn and Eva as co-managing members at 10 Park Avenue, with CT Corporation System as registered agent — administratively dissolved in September 2015 and reinstated in March 2016.

Dubin's FEC record shows over 147 contributions, predominantly to Democratic candidates and committees. Major donations include contributions to the American Exceptionalism PAC, Senate Majority PAC, and ActBlue, with repeated giving to New York representatives including Ritchie Torres and Dan Goldman. Some bipartisan giving appears (Vivek Ramaswamy, Dave McCormick), but no coordination pattern with other Epstein associates was detected. The Dubin Family Foundation (EIN 13-3863354), administered through UJA-Federation of New York, has been in terminal wind-down since 2011, with zero new contributions and assets approaching full depletion by 2024-2025.

Epstein also used Dubin as a conduit for Russian diplomatic access. In 2017, Epstein attempted to place Maxim Churkin — son of Russia's UN Ambassador Vitaly Churkin — at Dubin's firm, describing him as "son of the Russian amb." This use of Dubin's hedge fund operation as a placement vehicle for diplomatic contacts reflects the broader pattern of Epstein leveraging business relationships for intelligence-adjacent networking.

open_questions: Why did Dubin assign his economic interest in the Fortress fund to Jeepers Inc — an Epstein-controlled USVI entity — rather than receiving distributions directly? What legitimate financial purpose was served by routing $4.3 million through an entity that required Epstein's personal authorization to release funds back to Dubin?

What was the full scope of the Dubin-Epstein financial relationship beyond the documented Jeepers Inc flows? Dubin's 929 references in the DugganUSA corpus — among the highest for any individual — suggest a volume of interaction far exceeding what the 11 currently documented findings capture.

Did Eva Dubin have knowledge of or involvement in the encounters described in victim testimony? The SDNY prosecution memorandum references Maxwell directing a victim to 'massage Glen and Eva Dubin,' and Giuffre testified Eva was in the household during the alleged encounter. What is the evidentiary basis for Eva's inclusion in the directive?

What was the nature of the intelligence-sharing dynamic where Dubin forwarded sensitive financial articles about Leon Black to Epstein? Was this a systematic pattern of wealthy clients feeding Epstein commercially sensitive information about peers, and what did Epstein do with it?

Why did the Dubin family continue facilitating Celina Dubin's use of Epstein as a social reference in 2018 — a decade after his conviction — and what does this reveal about the family's assessment of reputational risk versus relationship value?
